title: Machine-voice labels
summary: A mono or pixel face as a secondary voice for labels, metadata, numbers and code. It's the machine talking, next to the human headline.
use_when: AI and dev products: anything where showing the machinery builds trust.
avoid_when: As body text past a sentence or two (TypeSafe's 12px mono body is the edge case).
